spellbook.finance/limitations: Documents are immutable saved PDFs. A refreshed URL retrieves the saved bytes; this read does not render a new PDF or create a receipt.

current_preparation means the document matches the case's current preparation and remains dispatchable only while the case stays unresolved. historical includes prior preparations and all prints after case resolution.
The read does not prove mailing or carrier acceptance. The print receipt records document creation only.
Workspace ownership is backend-enforced. This read returns buyer and destination details only for the workspace you own.

annotations.title: Read a returned-order case and its documents

description: Read one exact returned-order case, its original order and contents, inspection and dispatch history, and every saved replacement document. Each document carries a newly signed short-lived download URL, so use this read again when an older link expires or after a reship is resolved. Historical preparations are labeled explicitly. This owner-scoped read changes no return, shipment, inventory, postage or marketplace state.

caseId.description: The exact caseId from returned-order work or a record response. Required.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace that owns the returned order. Required.
